reviews.comment: Jill is one of the best professors at Mays if you actually care about the topics in the class. I took fixed income and macro with her and both were amazing, but if it's not something interesting to you they'll probably be way more work than other electives. I really liked that the class was built around reading books instead of a boring textbook.

Class isn't too hard, however Cetina's interest level on the subject is far above any students, which makes the class painfully boring. Exams aren't too hard, homework is annoying because you are not given much time to complete it. Cetina is a very intelligent woman, but her ego makes the class unbearable sometimes.

Cetina is a wonderful person. She might have the most relevant real world experience out of all the professors in Mays. She is passionate, but I think certain areas of the class could have been reviewed more in-depth, and the class was slightly too easy, so I didn't learn as much in this class as others. Go to office hours and chat with her!

Professor Cetina has been amazing! She teaches in a way that makes you excited to learn. Give yourself 1-2 hours to do the homework. Review lecture slides for exams, most stuff is pulled from lecture. Highly recommend going to class, not mandatory but helps you have a deep understanding of the concepts by relating it to real-world challenges.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is the only professor I have ever rated in my four years at A&M. I found Professor Cetina's class that enjoyable. She is not only very smart, but she has the industry experience to back up everything. Exams are fair and largely based on lectures. Most homework assignments go off the textbook. Liked this class, LOVED this prof. Take her. Do it.

Not only did I feel like I grasped a holistic understanding of fixed income, but she also made finance genuinely fun. She doesn't just teach—she instills a way of thinking that is invaluable for any finance professional. Her exams were MC and free response and I thought she graded more than fairly. She won't steer you wrong!

Hands down one of the best professors I have had the pleasure of having at Texas A&M. This is her first time teaching at A&M and she goes above and beyond to ensure you understand the material and make sure it is engaging. I CANNOT recommend her enough as she uses as much real world application as possible. Please take her! 4 exams with homework.
